facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run.
facts.freeRoam: Free-roam after the story, but no mission replay and no New Game+.
facts.manualSaves: 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave slot.
facts.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/) and PSNProfiles trophy list.

steps.goal: Finish the story, do the one thing that can be missed, and start the long counts early.
notes: Play Chapters 1–5 in order; all 12 story trophies pop automatically and none can be missed.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — the only missable trophy in the game.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go: 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals count toward 100%.
Take optional missions as they appear; you need any 100 for the 100% checklist and there are 200–300 in total.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 you can play as both characters and start the partner trophies.
steps.title: Step 1 — Story + optional missions, scan vehicles & animals
steps.trophies: Chapters 1–4, final mission, all 6 mission trophies, Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler, The Goodtime State, Positive Mental Attitude

steps.goal: Clear the 100% completion checklist in free-roam after the credits.
notes: The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts.
It is closer to 60% of true completion: most side quests and many collectibles are not required at all.

You need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, every robbery, all 8 large bank vaults, all 15 target decks and 15 of 18 meditation spots.
Only these need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Gold medals for all 42 shooting range challenges and wins at all 14 drone race locations live here too.
Cheats stay off: they disable trophies and saving.
steps.title: Step 2 — 100% completion checklist + 70 of 80 challenges
steps.trophies: A Long Road, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, Earn Cash, Not Kudos, One Last Thing, Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Whip It Good, Gunslinger, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Pest Control, Capital Offense, Personal Best, Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes, On the Spot, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!

steps.goal: Finish the side strands and whatever is left.
notes: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so clean them up now: 8 strands count, including Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Finish the five character questlines: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton (treasure dives), Billy (mud club), Randy (16 sports cars) and Tyrone (Jason only, labs).
Bret's hunting chain, the 500 criminal-profile actions, the UFO easter egg and the Payday Loans trophy (still unconfirmed at launch) close out here.
Every trophy-related quest giver is still available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.
steps.title: Step 3 — Strangers & Freaks + miscellaneous cleanup
steps.trophies: Strangers & Freaks, Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Fair Game, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin, Vice Got a Price!

warning.detail: After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. This session is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends, and no guide has confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it. Source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
warning.title: The only missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude
